meta.name: dnanexus-integration
meta.description: Build and operate reproducible genomics workloads on DNAnexus with the dx CLI, dxpy, apps/applets, native workflows, dxCompiler, and Nextflow. Use for DNAnexus data transfers, dxapp.json development, execution monitoring, workflow import, and project automation.

copy.tagline: 在DNAnexus上构建和运行可复现的基因组学工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在DNAnexus平台上自动化基因组学数据处理和运行分析流程
copy.tagline_en: Build and run reproducible genomics workflows on DNAnexus
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate genomics data processing and run analysis pipelines on the DNAnexus platform

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你操作 DNAnexus 云端基因分析平台:创建和部署分析程序、上传下载数据、运行和监控任务、写自动化脚本。
howto.when: 当你想在 DNAnexus 上处理基因数据(如 FASTQ、BAM、VCF)、创建分析程序、运行或监控任务时触发。

say.text: 把本地的 sample.fastq 上传到项目,并用 applet 跑比对。
say.note: Claude 会调用 dxpy 上传文件并启动分析任务。

say.text: 用 dxpy 查找项目里的 BAM 文件并下载到本地。
say.note: Claude 会用 dxpy 搜索并下载匹配的文件。

say.text: 帮我写一个 dxapp.json,定义输入、输出和依赖。
say.note: Claude 会生成或修改 dxapp.json 配置文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you operate the DNAnexus cloud genomics platform: create and deploy analysis programs, upload/download data, run and monitor tasks, and write automation scripts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to work with genomics data (e.g., FASTQ, BAM, VCF) on DNAnexus, create analysis programs, or run/monitor tasks.

say_en.text: Upload local sample.fastq to the project and run the applet for alignment.
say_en.note: Claude uploads the file and starts the job.

say_en.text: Use dxpy to find BAM files in the project and download them locally.
say_en.note: Claude searches and downloads matching files.

say_en.text: Create a dxapp.json with inputs, outputs, and dependencies.
say_en.note: Claude generates or edits the file.
